preconditions.name: pag_freeze_and_ilpfc_gate_engage_on_base
preconditions.description: The defensive chain must be present on ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY: PAG freezes (pag_n_commits>0 on >=2/3 seeds) AND the ilPFC gate engages (n_credit+n_decay>0 on >=2/3). Below-floor => the gate/freeze substrate the bridge extends is itself inert => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a bridge verdict.
preconditions.control: ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY: PAG + ilPFC gate + driver + fed harm stream + harm-pathway training (603k) + trained safety predictors (603j).

preconditions.name: each_enabled_bridge_half_fires_nonvacuously
preconditions.description: Each ENABLED bridge half must increment its credit on >=2/3 seeds (ARM_RELIEF_BRIDGE: mech358_n_relief_credit>0; ARM_SAFETY_BRIDGE: mech358_n_safety_credit>0; ARM_RELIEF_SAFETY_BRIDGE: both). The safety half credits via the trained MECH-303/304 threat-absence signal (603j); below-floor => the predictor did not populate ecologically => substrate_not_ready_requeue (NOT a false weakens).
preconditions.control: ARM_RELIEF/SAFETY/RELIEF_SAFETY: bridge ON, SD-056 e2 warmup in P0, fed harm stream, escape_use_trained_safety_signal + MECH-303/304/302 populating during Stage-H.

preconditions.name: harm_landscape_discriminative_on_base
preconditions.description: On ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY the 603k harm-pathway training must have made the harm landscape DISCRIMINATIVE (harm_eval_range >= 0.02 on >=2/3 seeds; 603i flat defect ~0.002, 603k trained ~0.133). Protects against the harder 603o env accidentally producing a flat harm landscape -> below-floor is substrate_not_ready_requeue (a nav/training ceiling), NOT a bridge verdict. SAME statistic the survival leg depends on (a trained harm gradient is the substrate the bridge sits on top of).

preconditions.name: stage0_forced_feed_lights_zgoal_on_base
preconditions.description: Stage-0 forced supra-threshold benefit lights z_goal (>0.4) on >=2/3 base seeds -- the goal-FORMATION positive control.

grid.relief_only_lift: relief (phasic negative-reinforcement) credit carries the survival lift
grid.safety_only_lift: safety (learned threat-absence) credit carries the survival lift
grid.both_required_lift: directed escape needs complementary relief + safety bridge
grid.no_lift_and_nav_control_incompetent: navigation/survival-competence ceiling on the harder env -> nav substrate, NOT the bridge
